items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I went down to the hotel where he was livin', the Dunbar, to see him

ctx.x: Yeah, he's black. He is a prize fighter. I went down to the hotel where he was livin', the Dunbar, to see him and he was getting dressed to meet her. But he don't know I know why he's getting dressed. He don't know this. But he gets himself dressed and I say, "I'll see you again, man, have a good night."
